mapper.select: SELECT id,phone,password,status,cancel_status FROM app_user WHERE phone=#{phone} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET last_login_time=NOW(),last_login_ip=#{ip} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.user_id,u.phone FROM auth_refresh_token t JOIN app_user u ON u.id=t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash=#{hash} AND t.revoked_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at>NOW() AND u.status='0' AND u.cancel_status='0'
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_refresh_token SET revoked_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE auth_refresh_token SET revoked_at=NOW() WHERE token_hash=#{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_device(user_id,device_id,platform,device_model,system_version,app_version,last_active_time,status) VALUES(#{userId},#{deviceId},#{platform},#{model},#{systemVersion},#{appVersion},NOW(),'0') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform=VALUES(platform),device_model=VALUES(device_model),system_version=VALUES(system_version),app_version=VALUES(app_version),last_active_time=NOW(),status='0'
